name: auto-continue
description: When a turn stops on a used-up quota, wait for the window to reset and send a prompt to carry on, if the reset comes within the wait you allow

enabledByDefault.title: Enabled by default
enabledByDefault.description: Turn auto-continue on in every new session

maxWaitHours.title: Longest wait (hours)
maxWaitHours.description: Carry on only when the quota resets within this many hours of running out

prompt.title: Prompt sent on reset
prompt.description: What is sent to carry the work on once the quota resets
prompt.default: 额度已刷新，请从中断的地方继续完成刚才的任务。

windows.title: Which quota to wait for
windows.description: seven_day: the weekly quota only; any: the weekly or the 5-hour one
